```{r}
required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "ggplot2",
  "cluster", "factoextra", "FPDclustering"
)

installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(FPDclustering)
```

# 1. Load embeddings
```{r}
embedding_path <- "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv"

embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path)

user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1]

embedding_matrix <- as.matrix(embedding_matrix)
embedding_matrix <- scale(embedding_matrix)

dim(embedding_matrix)
head(user_ids)
```

# 2. Inspect possible factor dimensions
```{r}
TuckerFactors(embedding_matrix, 6)
```

# 3. Tune number of clusters and factor dimension 

```{r}
k_range <- 2:10
q_range <- 2:6

dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

results_grid <- expand.grid(k = k_range, q = q_range)
results_grid$asw <- NA

fpdc_models <- vector("list", nrow(results_grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_grid))) {
  k_val <- results_grid$k[i]
  q_val <- results_grid$q[i]
  
  cat("Running FPDC with k =", k_val, "and q =", q_val, "\n")
  
  model <- FPDC(
    embedding_matrix,
    k_val,
    50,
    q_val
  )
  
  labels <- model$label
  
  sil <- silhouette(labels, dmat)
  avg_sil <- mean(sil[, 3])
  
  results_grid$asw[i] <- avg_sil
  fpdc_models[[i]] <- model
}

results_grid
```

# 4. Find best model
```{r}
best_index <- which.max(results_grid$asw)
best_params <- results_grid[best_index, ]

best_k <- best_params$k
best_q <- best_params$q
best_asw <- best_params$asw

best_fpdc <- fpdc_models[[best_index]]

best_params
```

# 5. Plot tuning results
```{r}
ggplot(results_grid, aes(x = q, y = asw, color = factor(k), group = k)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Factorial PD Clustering Tuning Results",
    x = "Factor Dimension (q)",
    y = "Average Silhouette Width",
    color = "Clusters (k)"
  )
```

# 6. Cluster assignments
```{r}
cluster_df <- data.frame(
  UserID = user_ids,
  Cluster = best_fpdc$label
)

head(cluster_df)
table(cluster_df$Cluster)
```

# 7. Silhouette plot for best solution
```{r}
best_sil <- silhouette(best_fpdc$label, dmat)

plot(
  best_sil,
  main = paste("Factorial PD Clustering Silhouette Plot (k =", best_k, ", q =", best_q, ")"),
  col = "blue",
  border = NA
)
```

# 8. PCA visualization
```{r}
pca <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  Cluster = as.factor(best_fpdc$label)
)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Factorial PD Clustering (PCA Projection): k =", best_k, ", q =", best_q),
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2"
  )
```

# 9. Probability-based silhouette
```{r}
Silh(best_fpdc$probability)
```

# 10. Save results
```{r}
write.csv(
  cluster_df,
  file = paste0("output/fpdc_clusters_k", best_k, "_q", best_q, ".csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  results_grid,
  file = "output/fpdc_tuning_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
